title: Phase decomposition behavior and its effects on mechanical properties of TiNbTa0.5ZrAl0.5 refractory high entropy alloy
process_method_2: powder metallurgy+cold isostatic pressing+vacuum sintering+hot forging+annealing
process_description: prepared by powder metallurgy method using elemental powders with purities above 99.5% and average particle sizes of 18-42 μm. The powders were blended under argon atmosphere, underwent cold isostatic pressing and vacuum sintering, then hot forged at 1500°C with 50% height reduction, and subsequently annealed at corresponding forging temperature for 30 min.
